protocol: Population one-step Q convergence with fixed validation queries, no class-center classifier; four reference sizes and 12 independent reference replicates

not_applicable.reason: This study compares one-step transition label distributions against a population reference; it does not construct class centers or a classifier.

not_measured.reason: Individual 416 query-feature comparison distances per reference replicate were not retained; only trial means and p95 TV are available.
The original run retained mean(sqrt(JSD)) for replicates; mean JSD cannot be inferred by squaring mean sqrt(JSD). A separate mean JSD is recorded for the single original N=300 reference.

measured_details: single reference N=300: mean/median/p95 TV, mean JSD, sqrt-JSD, L1 and per-feature TV
12 independent reference samples nested across N=300,1000,3000,10000, each recorded mean TV, mean sqrt-JSD and p95(TV)
reference-size comparison mean and between-seed standard deviation of mean TV, per-feature TV aggregate
